Slop To-do · free, in your browser

A free Todoist alternative with no account

Slop To-do is a simple task manager that runs in your browser and keeps your tasks on your device. Lists, tags, subtasks, priorities, repeats and reminders are all there.

Open Slop To-do

How to do it

  1. Open Slop To-do. There is no sign-up.
  2. Type tasks in Add a task and press Enter after each one.
  3. Press Details… to add a due date and time, a priority, a list, tags or a repeat.
  4. Keep work and home apart with lists, and check Today and Upcoming each morning.
  5. Tick To-dos in Slop Calendar to see timed tasks next to your events.

Slop To-do is for one person on one device: there is no sharing, no assigning tasks to other people and no sync. Subtasks go one level deep, and you change a date in the task editor rather than by dragging.

Your files stay on this device: Slop To-do runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slopographic part of Todoist?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with Todoist or Doist. Todoist is a trademark of its owner, named here only for comparison.

Does it work on a phone?

Yes, in the phone's browser: at narrow widths the views become a row of buttons. Tasks are kept in that browser only.

What happens when I complete a repeating task?

Its due date moves to the next time it repeats and it stays open, until the repeat's end day.

Can I search my tasks?

Yes. Find searches your tasks, and Show done brings back the ones you have completed.
